observation.command:
echo "=== FINAL VERIFICATION ==="
echo "-- docker available --"; docker version --format '{{.Server.Version}}' 2>&1
echo "-- project images built --"; docker images --format '{{.Repository}}' | grep -viE 'ghcr.io|nginx|python|node|hello-world|^<none>' | sort -u | wc -l
echo "-- base images --"; docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep -E 'demospipes-base'
echo "-- sample image import checks --"
for c in "xoev-adapter:xoev_adapter" "fristenmanagement:fristenmanagement" "norm-matching:normen_extraktion" "graph-api:graph_api" "ki-guv-feedback:feedback_api" "demospipes-base-api:demospipes_api"; do
  img=${c%%:*}; mod=${c##*:}
  printf "  %-22s " "$img"; timeout 50 docker run --rm --entrypoint sh "$img" -c "/app/.venv/bin/python -c 'import ${mod}' 2>/dev/null && echo IMPORT_OK || python -c 'import ${mod}' 2>/dev/null && echo IMPORT_OK || echo CHECK" 2>/dev/null
done
echo "-- frontend dist --"; ls /workspace/01-frontend/shell/dist/index.html /workspace/01-frontend/shared/dist/index.js >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo FRONTEND_BUILT
